about: Explicit skip allowlist for CI JUnit gates (.github/scripts/ci_gates.py). Every reason names where the skipped tests really execute. Counts were measured on a CI-equivalent checkout (tracked files only, no ai-engine/artifacts, no DSNs) on 2026-09-24, re-measured on 2026-09-24 22:40 for the gateway-header reason (13) and on 2026-09-25 for the DSN reason (314 across 23 suites, matching the integrators' real-store runs) after other owners added tests (ai lane: full suite on a tracked-files-only snapshot, 445 cases). Adding a skip needs a reviewed bump here; an unlisted reason always fails.

reasons.why: Real PostgreSQL/Redis contracts; executed with zero skips by disposable-integration.yml database-contracts (drift-checked file list).
Real Redis stream-retention races; executed with zero skips by disposable-integration.yml stream-retention.
Real nginx gateway headers; executed with zero skips by quality.yml gateway-headers.

reasons.pattern: ^nginx executable required for live forwarding test$
reasons.why: Real nginx login-IP proxy boundary; executed with zero skips by quality.yml gateway-proxy-boundary (hosted runners may lack nginx here).
Owner opt-in lane RUN_DISTRIBUTED_REALTIME=1 (isolated multi-API Docker acceptance); not run on hosted CI.
Owner opt-in lane NANFO_LIVE_PROVIDER_POSTGRES=1 (disposable Docker live-provider worker); not run on hosted CI.

reasons.pattern: ^explicit private fleet PG/Redis and local SNMP acceptance required$
reasons.why: Owner opt-in lane FLEET_LOCAL_SNMP=1 with FLEET_TEST_DSN/FLEET_TEST_REDIS_URL and a local snmpd; not run on hosted CI.

reasons.pattern: ^Opt-in replay of local real lab captures, not live tenant authorization$
reasons.why: Owner opt-in lane NANFO_REPLAY_PROBE_CAPTURE=1 replaying private lab captures; not run on hosted CI.
Private evidence lane NANFO_TEST_ADR013_CAMPAIGN_ROOT=<immutable campaign>; historical bytes are never published to CI.

reasons.pattern: ^parent has not supplied a pinned actual native v2 capture$
reasons.why: Private evidence lane NANFO_NATIVE_REPLAY_ROOT + NANFO_NATIVE_REPLAY_RECEIPT_SHA256 (read-only native capture replay).
Private evidence lane NANFO_NATIVE_DRIVER_EVIDENCE=<retained native driver evidence>.
Private evidence lane NANFO_REBUILT_CHECKPOINT_TEST=<derived checkpoint> (read-only lineage check).

Private evidence lane with ai-engine/artifacts present (cd ai-engine && uv run --no-sync pytest -m private_artifacts): one module-level skip per module listed in ai-engine/tests/private_artifacts.txt (test_refinement.py, test_refinement_long.py); their historical plans pin those ignored bytes.
